empty_inventory: No inventory items yet. Add items or load the taco-truck demo.
setup_hint: Set your truck name and preferred units. Saved locally.
menu_hint: Build each plate from catalog items. Cost per plate uses each item's cost per unit.
label_ingredients: Ingredients (qty per plate, in the item's unit)
sales_hint: Export item sales from your POS as CSV and upload it. OSFT guesses the format; fix the column mapping if needed.
unverified: ⚠ Column names not yet verified against a real export — check the preview.
unmatched: Not linked to a menu item (add the POS name on the Menu tab)
sales_var_hint: Theoretical usage (sales × recipes) vs. counted usage (start count + received − end count) between your last two full counts. Daily partial counts in between don't distort it; items only on a daily list use their own last count.
var_explain: Positive = more used than sales explain (waste, over-portioning, comps, theft or a missing receive).
stops_hint: Set PAR per stop (lunch, brewery, festival…). Blank = item's everyday PAR.
stops_empty: No stop types yet — add one.
short_items: items short — buy or prep before loading
par_from_item: No stop PAR set — using the item's everyday PAR.
ai_hint: Off by default. When on, a photo you choose is sent to the AI service with YOUR API key, and it suggests lines for you to confirm. Nothing is applied automatically.
ai_confirm: Check against the invoice, then log the receives by hand.
example_note: Items marked EXAMPLE are demo data.
foot_hint: Your numbers update every time you complete a count.
home_sub: Your truck's numbers and quick paths — live after every count.
jc_count_s: Big taps · zone by zone · one-hand friendly
jc_order_s: What to buy, grouped by vendor
hdr_catalog: Every item, its unit, PAR, zone and cost.
hdr_zones: What's on the truck right now, zone by zone.
hdr_count: Walk the truck zone by zone. Progress saves as you go.
hdr_variance: Counted vs. PAR, from your last completed count.
hdr_receive: Log deliveries and snap the invoice.
hdr_menu: Build each plate from catalog items.
hdr_sales: Square, Toast, Clover or any CSV.
hdr_stops: Set PARs per stop and print tomorrow's load.
hdr_setup: Truck name, language and optional AI reading.
hdr_reports: What sales say you used vs. what your counts show — in dollars.
hdr_reorder: Everything under PAR, grouped by the vendor you last bought it from.
no_counted_items: No counted items in last session.
setup_incomplete: Setup incomplete — set your truck name in Settings.
all_at_par: All items at or above PAR. Nice work!
no_counts_start: No counts yet. Start a count walk by zone.
added_no_prices: Added. Prices are blank — type in what you actually pay.
backups_hint: A backup is saved automatically before every reset or restore. Download one to keep it off this computer.
barcode_unsupported: Barcode scanning needs Chrome on Android or desktop. Type the code instead.
board_new: Leave a note for the crew…
categories_hint: Group products for cost reports. GL codes are optional — ask your bookkeeper.
confirm_delete_truck: Delete this truck and all its data?
confirm_seed: Load the sample taco truck? This replaces this truck's products and counts (a backup is made first).
copy_failed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it.
hdr_data: Backups, restore, sample data and resets.
hdr_invoice: Type in an invoice to add stock and update costs.
hdr_log: Everything that came in: sales, invoices, orders, transfers.
hdr_money: Food cost, stock value and history.
hdr_orders: Turn the reorder list into vendor orders.
hdr_people: Who can log in and what they can do.
hdr_starter: Pick common food-truck products. No prices are filled in.
hdr_trucks: Run more than one truck and move stock between them.
hdr_vendors: Who you buy from and how to reach them.
hdr_voice: Say what you see. We match it to your list.
import_hint: Columns: name, unit, par, cost, category, zone, vendor, sku, barcode. Matching names are updated.
import_or_paste: Upload a CSV or paste it below
invoice_hint: One line per product: name, quantity, price. We match names to your list.
login_who: Pick your name and enter your PIN.
mic_error: Mic error — try again or type below.
mic_stopped: Stopped. Check the text, then tap Check.
mic_unsupported: This browser can't listen. Type instead (Chrome or Safari can listen).
money_not_ready: Add sales and at least two counts to see food cost.
ob_account_hint: Make a 6-digit PIN so only your crew can get in. You can skip this and stay open.
ob_business_hint: This shows on orders and reports.
ob_done_body: Your list is set. Count every week and the reorder sheet fills itself.
ob_first_hint: Use what you just said as your first count?
ob_review_hint: Fix anything we misheard. Set a par (how much you want on hand).
ob_sample_hint: Just looking? Load a demo truck with made-up numbers marked EXAMPLE.
ob_updates: Tell me about updates (saved on this device only)
ob_walk_example: e.g. “cooler: 3 cases chicken thighs, 2 tubs crema, 12 limes”
ob_walk_hint: Walk your truck and say or type what you keep. Zone first, then items.
ob_welcome_1: Say what you see — we build your list
ob_welcome_3: Know what to order before you run out
ob_welcome_body: About five minutes. Nothing leaves this computer.
open_mode_long: Open mode: anyone with this link can get in. Add an admin with a PIN to lock it.
orders_from_list: Build orders from the reorder list, grouped by vendor.
people_hint: Admins do everything. Managers run a shift. Crew counts.
people_none: No one yet — the app is open.
po_recv_hint: Change any amount that came in different.
pos_accounts_hint: Which register accounts feed sales in. Used to label imports.
rerun_confirm: Run setup again? Your products stay.
reset_all_hint: Erases every truck, person and setting. Type RESET to confirm.
reset_confirm: Clear this truck's products and counts? A backup is made first.
reset_truck_hint: Clears products, counts and logs for this truck only.
restore_confirm: Replace current data with this backup?
restore_hint: Upload a backup .zip or .json you downloaded before.
sample_hint: Fills this truck with demo products and counts, all marked EXAMPLE.
starter_hint: Tick what you carry. Pars and prices start blank — fill in your own.
transfer_hint: Move stock from this truck to another.
transfer_need_two: Add a second truck to transfer stock.
voice_all_set: All set — nothing left to fix.
voice_hint: Say a zone, then items and amounts: “cooler, chicken 3 cases, crema 2”.
voice_not_said_hint: These weren't mentioned. Keep last count or set to zero.
voice_text_label: What you said (you can edit it)
voice_tips: Tips: say the unit if it's not the normal one. “Half” and “and a half” work.
walk_nothing: We didn't catch any products. Try again or skip.
zones_extra_hint: Turn on any extra place you store things.
walk_placeholder: Type or talk: cooler, 3 cases chicken…
voice_placeholder: Type or talk: chicken 3 cases, crema 2…
hdr_sections: The places you keep things, in the order you walk them.
hdr_ai: Only if you want it: read invoice photos and build shelves from a picture.
sec_hint: Name them the way your crew talks. Put them in the order you walk the truck — counts follow this order.
ai_switch: Use AI (off = nothing is ever sent)
ai_key_note: Stored on this computer only, inside the program's data folder. It is never shown again or included in backups.
ai_settings_hint: OSFT works fully without AI. Turn this on to let an AI service you choose read invoice photos and suggest products from a shelf photo. Files are sent only when you press an AI button, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
ai_use_1: Reads an invoice photo or PDF into vendor, date and lines you check before receiving.
ai_use_2: Looks at a shelf photo and suggests the products and counts for that section.
ai_use_3: Tidies a messy spoken walk into a clean product list.
ob11_welcome_body: Setup works like a walk-through of your truck. You talk, we write it down, you check it.
ob11_p1_1: Name your sections: cooler, lowboy, dry shelf, cab — whatever you have.
ob11_p1_2: Walk them one at a time and say what's there (or type it).
ob11_p1_3: Check the list and approve your map.
ob11_p2_1: Count each section, by voice or by typing.
ob11_p2_2: That count becomes your starting point for usage and reorders.
ob11_tip: Tip: speak naturally — “ground beef 14 pounds, cheese 6, tortillas 3 cases”. You can fix anything before it's saved.
ob11_ai_body: With AI on you can snap a shelf to fill a section, and read invoice photos. You can also do this later in Settings › AI.
ob11_ai_failed: AI was left off. Check the key, or skip and set it up later.
ob11_sections_hint: Where do things live? Add, rename, reorder or delete — make it match your truck.
ob11_sections_hint2: Order them the way you'd walk the truck. You'll go through them in this order.
ob11_walk_hint: Tap the mic and say what's in this section — names, and amounts if you know them. Or type it.
ob11_howto_1: One product at a time, amount after the name: “cheese 6, sour cream 2 tubs”.
ob11_howto_2: Commas or pauses between products are fine.
ob11_howto_3: Unsure of the count? Just say the name — you'll count in Pass 2.
ob11_walk_example: Example: “ground beef 14 pounds, chicken thigh 20 pounds, shredded cheese 6 bags, crema 2 tubs”.
ob11_walk_ph: ground beef 14 pounds, cheese 6, crema 2 tubs…
ob11_ai_hint_off: Want to snap a photo of this shelf instead? Turn on AI in Settings › AI.
ob11_ai_reading: AI is reading… nothing is saved until you confirm.
ob11_ai_review_note: Suggested by AI — check names and amounts. Untick anything that's wrong.
ob11_review_hint: Every product, section by section. Fix names, move things, set PAR (how many you want on hand).
ob11_count_hint: Say or type the counts, then check the numbers below and save this section.
ob11_account_hint: Add an owner PIN so staff can only see what you allow. Skip it if it's just you — you can add people later in Settings › People.
ob11_done_body: Your truck is mapped and your first count is in. From here: count by voice, receive invoices, and watch what to reorder.
inv11_hint_ai: Add a photo or PDF of the invoice. AI reads it into lines you check, match and save.
inv11_hint_manual: Add a photo or PDF to keep with this receive, then enter the lines below.
inv11_turn_on: Turn it on in Settings › AI
inv11_attached_manual: Attached — it will be saved with the lines you enter below.
inv11_review_note: Read by AI — nothing is saved until you press save. Match each line to a product, or add it as new.
ob12_inv_ask: Have recent product invoices? Add them right here too — PDFs, photos, or CSV. I'll match them to what you say, carry over pack size, unit, cost and vendor, and ask you about anything on the invoices that isn't in a section yet.
ob12_inv_hint_ai: Upload one or multiple files. AI reads each invoice into lines; we merge them in Reconcile — nothing is saved until you confirm.
ob12_inv_hint_off: AI is off: CSV files and PDFs with a text layer are read here as best effort. Photos and scanned PDFs need AI (Settings → AI) — or type the lines below.
ob12_lead: Pass 1 wrap-up: we merge what you said in each section with your invoices — with blanks where we're uncertain. We never silently fix your truck; you see every gap before you approve.
ob12_summary: {m} of {p} products matched an invoice · {u} invoice products to reconcile on the map
ob12_no_invoices: No invoices added — that's fine. Go back to the walk to add some, or continue and add costs later.
ob12_unplaced_title: On your invoices but not in any section ({n})
ob12_unplaced_hint: Tell me what to do with each one. Nothing is saved until you press Confirm.
ob12_not_on_map: Not on your walk map — put it in a section, or tell me it isn't kept on the truck.
ob12_nocost_title: Spoken but not on any invoice ({n})
ob12_nocost_hint: These have no cost yet. Add an invoice for them, or set costs later in Products.
ob13_match_to: Match to a product on the map…
ob13_no_link: Not matched to any invoice line.
ob13_not_saved: Changes show here right away but are saved only when you press Confirm & continue.
ob13_pending: {n} unsaved change(s) — saved when you press Confirm & continue.
ob13_tap_hint: Tap a row to fix it here — name, section, count, unit, pack, cost, vendor, or the invoice match.
ob13_unit_note: You said {a}; the invoice says {b}. Fix the unit (and count) if the walk got it wrong.
ct_hdr: Daily, weekly and monthly counts — and what each one covers.
ct_partial_note: partial count of {n} products. Anything not on this list keeps its last count — it is never zeroed or flagged missing.
ct_full_note: full count. Anything left blank inside this scope will be listed as missing.
ct_partial_short: partial; the rest keep their last count
ct_kept: {n} not counted kept their last on-hand
ct_settings_hint: Daily end-of-shift counts cover just a watch list (sections, categories or picked products). Weekly is the full truck. Monthly adds in-depth extras. Partial counts never zero what they skip.
ct_exclude: Leave these sections out (e.g. commissary on weekly)
ct_allowed: Count types this person can start
ct_allowed_hint: Leave all unticked to allow every type. Tick only Daily to keep crew on end-of-shift counts.
sv_skipped_partials: Daily partial counts in between were skipped for this report: {n}
promo_lead: You already run Open Source Food Truckin for free. We also give away Open Source Barware for bars and Reservation Relief.
promo_tagline: Stop paying competitors to deliver customers to you. Own that traffic yourself.
promo_rr: Take orders and bookings (catering, private events) on the website you already own. Don't pay a platform to hand your own customers back to you.
promo_osbw: Free open-source bar inventory, with the same local-first DNA as this truck program.
hdr_library: The full manual for this program. Search it, follow a path, or ask Help.
lib_none: Nothing found. Try fewer or different words.
help_connect: Connect your own AI in Settings › AI and Help becomes a tutor that walks you through every step.
help_hello: Ask me how anything in Open Source Food Truckin' works. I answer from the Library and link the pages I used.
help_hello_ai: Ask me anything about the program. I'm connected to your AI, so I can walk you through it step by step and look at your truck's numbers. I read them; I never change anything.
help_ph: e.g. How do I count only the cooler at night?
help_none: I couldn't find that in the Library. Try other words, or open Something looks wrong.
help_ai_failed: Your AI didn't answer ({e}). Here's the Library instead.
help_done: That's the whole path. Ask me anything about it.
help_suggest_2: How do I count only the cooler at night?
help_suggest_3: Why is my variance so big?
